summary.text: If you are eligible for a subsidised vaccination, ask your preferred clinic if you can pay the remaining co-payment with MediSave.

details.heading: Where MediSave can be used
details.body: Those eligible for subsidised vaccination may use MediSave to cover the out-of-pocket expense at CHAS GP clinics and polyclinics.

steps.name: Ask your clinic
steps.text: Ask your preferred clinic if it can process the remaining co-payment through MediSave.

items: Ask your preferred clinic if it can process the remaining co-payment via MediSave.

steps.name: Check your eligibility
steps.text: If the clinic can process the co-payment through MediSave, check with them if you are eligible to pay that way.

items: If the clinic can process the co-payment through MediSave, check with them on your eligibility to pay via MediSave.

Please check with your preferred clinic if the clinic is able to process the remaining co-payment via MediSave.
If they do, please check with them on your eligibility to pay via MediSave.
